description: Image bumps for the pinned compose files arrive as PRs; merging one deploys via the normal workflow. Scope is deliberately narrow: docker-compose only, opti + rpi only. noblenumbat stays out until its host-only services are in the repo (a push there runs --remove-orphans).

packageRules.description: Vault DB: stay on the 11.8 LTS line; a major/minor jump is a deliberate migration, not a bump.
